title: Role-specific logical MLP views over a shared transcoder bank
hypothesis: For four context roles defined from fit-only residual-input clusters, a shared 32-atom transcoder feature bank with role-specific 16-angle Givens Views and top-8 decoding reduces held-out role-conditioned native-MLP output error by at least 10% versus both ordinary per-role sparse feature gates and a byte-near role-diagonal gain control, without increasing shared physical transcoder state.
physical_object: Pinned SmolLM2-135M layer-8 skip-transcoder, shared 32-atom decoder bank selected from fit activations.
mirror_coordinate: Per-role 16-angle Givens transform over the 32-dimensional sparse feature code before retaining top-8 coefficients and decoding with the shared feature atoms.
logical_multiplicity: Four residual-input cluster roles; each has its own small coordinate/view code but shares one transcoder bank.
controls: Native dense layer-8 MLP output (zero-error reference)
Hard-tied shared 32-atom transcoder bank with top-8 coefficients
Role-specific frozen sparse feature gates: per-role support is the 8 atoms with highest mean positive fit activation
Role-specific learned diagonal gains on the same 32 atoms then top-8 decode (simple FiLM/gate control)
Role-specific learned Givens Mirror views on the same 32 atoms then top-8 decode
Four independent dense MLP copies (storage/quality upper reference; no training)

task.primary_metric: mean role-balanced raw MLP-output relative MSE on held-out tokens
secondary_metrics: actual serialized incremental and standalone bytes
task.bank_deployment: Store only the selected 32 encoder rows, selected 32 decoder rows, their biases, and the skip matrix; charge these actual serialized bytes rather than charging unused full checkpoint tensors.

development.fit_eval_windows: 16 fit and 16 evaluation unique aligned 128-token blocks; no overlap
development.role_assignment: Fit K=4 centroids on fit-half layer-8 MLP input vectors; assign each token by nearest centroid. Centroids fit on development data only.
development.feature_bank: On fit half, rank all 73,728 features by summed positive top-128 encoder activation and retain 32. At inference serialize/use only those 32 encoder/decoder rows, bias entries, and the shared skip matrix.
development.givens_pattern: Pair consecutive coordinates; initialize zero angles and learn on fit only.
development.optimization: Optimize only Givens angles and diagonal gains with fixed Adam settings, 200 updates, batch size 256, lr 0.01, one CPU thread. Plain per-role supports are deterministic fit-only selections. No settings chosen using evaluation.
development.selection_metric: Mean role-balanced held-out raw output relative MSE; no fresh access before the gate.
development.plain_gate: For each role, freeze support to 8 bank atoms with highest mean positive fit activation in that role; all other bank activations are zeroed.

fresh.eval_windows: 32 unique aligned 128-token validation blocks, all used as evaluation; no fit/calibration on validation. Use frozen development centroids, bank, supports, diagonal gains, and Mirror angles.
fresh.access_condition: Open only if dev Mirror improves mean relative MSE by >=10% over both per-role plain sparse gates and diagonal gain control, worst-role MSE <=1.25x mean, and actual payloads/compute are measured.

storage.serialization: Safetensors for transcoder state, bank indices, role centroids, Givens angles and diagonal gains; canonical JSON configs; serialize native MLP replacement base with layer-8 MLP removed.
paid_objects: base model excluding replaced native MLP
only selected shared 32 encoder/decoder atom rows, biases, and skip matrix
role centroids are charged only for role-conditioned methods; hard-tied shared-bank control has no router state

compute.report_inference_latency: Per-method inference wall time includes role routing when needed, bank encoding, selected top-8 decode, and the shared skip path; report full-transcoder and native MLP references.

success_gate: On each fresh seed, Mirror role-balanced relative MSE must be at least 10% below both per-role plain sparse gate and diagonal gain control, with worst-role MSE <=1.25x average. Report the full serialized replacement payload and compute; no capacity claim from role count alone.
failure_gate: Development Mirror fails to beat either cheap control by the frozen 10% margin, or worst-role MSE >1.25x mean; fresh remains sealed.
boundaries: Role clusters are fit-derived input distribution groups, not independent semantic experts.
Output reconstruction is a mechanism/quality screen, not end-task language-model quality or independent capacity.
The previous MA-533 failed generic transcoder fidelity; MA-534 tests whether role-specific views improve approximations over a shared sparse feature bank.
Single model/checkpoint/layer and one 32-atom bank only.
The full 73,728-feature source checkpoint is needed during bank selection but unused rows are not in the inference payload; the exact selected-bank payload is serialized and charged.

amendments.before-measurement-rerun: The first development run completed its quality metrics but the frozen results did not include isolated per-method wall times. Repeat the identical seed, windows, feature bank, optimizer and 200 updates solely to add isolated inference/training timing and learned-coordinate summaries. No setting or gate may change; fresh validation remains sealed.
